snippet.title: FEE3 2025: Life of Seiros by Augenis
snippet.description:
First showcased on FEE3 2024, Life of Seiros is a work-in-progress FE8 hack set as a prequel to the story of Fire Emblem: Three Houses. With 13 chapters already finished and more on the way, it follows Rhea on her quest of justice, vengeance and lies to become the saviour of Fódlan, Saint Seiros.

The hack can be found here!:

https://feuniverse.us/t/fe8-life-of-seiros-13-chapters-act-1-done/25600
